clips.title: The story
paras: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Supervisor Raelen keeps timber moving toward Stormwind. She manages the laborers, tracks daily quotas, and oversees the lumber supply.

Supervisor Raelen directs the woodcutters at Eastvale Logging Camp, near Marshal Patterson and the camp’s wagons. The camp stands on the edge of eastern Elwynn, near the Redridge Mountains, where the work brings its share of trouble. Raelen coordinates the crews and keeps them focused on their quotas despite hazards in the surrounding woods. She sees that gathered timber is processed, bundled, and sent on toward Stormwind.
